description:
A set of ten sterling silver teaspoons in a mix of patterns. Four have richly embossed floral handles, including roses, a vine-wrapped lily bloom, mistletoe and berries, and a trailing blossom with a bud. A pierced Colorado souvenir spoon has a raised columbine flower. Three share an ornate rococo scroll and shell handle. One has an Art Deco heart accent, and one has a smooth, pointed handle with a monogram. Two bowls are engraved with the name “Ruth.” The warm rainbow patina highlights the detail on every piece. It would suit tea or coffee service, a serious spoon collection, a gift set, or a display of assorted antique flatware.
Details:
Style: Ten assorted teaspoons: four Art Nouveau floral, one pierced Colorado souvenir, three rococo scroll and shell, one Art Deco heart accent, one pointed monogrammed handle
Color: Sterling silver with warm gold and rainbow patina

Marks: Stamped “Sterling” on the back of the stems, with assorted maker’s marks

All ten spoons are complete and solid, with deep, well-defined detail on the handles. The engraved name “Ruth” is clear on two of the bowls, and the monogram on the pointed handle is softly worn.
